title: Szent-Györgyi Albert and the Szeged Laboratory
grammar: Past probability with valószínűleg and biztosan, and counterfactual prerequisites with nélkül
goal: I can narrate how Albert Szent-Györgyi's research in Szeged on paprika and vitamin C led to the 1937 Nobel Prize.
I can say what could not have happened without a key step (nélkül ... nem ... volna) and what probably happened (valószínűleg, biztosan).
I can discuss biochemistry, cellular respiration, and scientific intuition in Hungarian.
